chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yasser, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to me: 'My beloved Jibraeel (peace be upon him) said to me: Apply perfume one day, and one day do not, and the day of Friday is inevitable from it, and do not neglect it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling or recommendation regarding the use of perfume on Fridays?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*, this hadith highlights the spiritual and physical purification associated with *ittibāʿ al-fiṭrah* (following the natural disposition), linking the Prophet’s daily routine to the Angel Jibraeel’s guidance. It underscores the Friday prayer (*Ṣalāt al-Jumuʿah*) as a weekly occasion for personal adornment, reflecting the Shia emphasis on combining inner piety with outward cleanliness as a form of worship.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Yasser, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to me: ‘My<sup>saww</sup> beloved Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> said to me: ‘Apply perfume one day, and one day don’t, and the day of Friday is inevitable from it, and do not neglect it’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from [his father] from Yasar who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘My friend Jibril has told me to apply perfume one day and not on the next day. On Friday it is necessary and it must not be ignored.’”
